title: Flutter
label: FL
desc: Cross-platform UI toolkit that compiles Dart to native code for mobile, web, and desktop.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the SDK, check the toolchain, scaffold an app, and run it on a device

snippets.code:
# Print the Flutter and Dart versions on the PATH
flutter --version

# Check the Android, iOS, web, and desktop toolchains
flutter doctor -v

# Scaffold an app with a concrete organisation id
flutter create --org com.example --platforms android,ios,web counter
cd counter

# List the devices and emulators the tool can target
flutter devices

# Run a debug build on one device id
flutter run -d emulator-5554

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.description: One folder per feature, shared code under core, and the generated platform runners

snippets.code:
# The generated layout: lib/ holds Dart code, test/ mirrors it
find lib test -type f | sort

# Grow the app by feature, not by file type
# lib/main.dart              entry point, runApp
# lib/app.dart               MaterialApp, theme, routes
# lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart
# lib/features/counter/counter_page.dart
# lib/features/counter/counter_controller.dart
mkdir -p lib/core/theme lib/features/counter

# Re-resolve packages after editing pubspec.yaml
flutter pub get

sections.title: Assets
sections.description: Bundle images and text files declared in pubspec.yaml, then load them by path

snippets.code:
# Create the folders that pubspec.yaml points at
mkdir -p assets/images assets/data
cp ~/Downloads/logo.png assets/images/logo.png

# Fetch packages and rebuild the asset bundle
flutter pub get

# A renamed or deleted asset needs a clean build to disappear
flutter clean
flutter pub get

sections.title: Theming
sections.description: One seed colour feeds a full ColorScheme, with light and dark variants

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Widget tests pump the real widget tree and assert on what the user sees

snippets.code:
# Run every test under test/
flutter test

# Run one file, or filter by test name
flutter test test/widget_test.dart
flutter test test/widget_test.dart --name 'increments'

# Write coverage/lcov.info for the CI report
flutter test --coverage

sections.title: Build and Release
sections.description: Split per ABI for size, define API URLs at compile time, and keep debug symbols

snippets.code:
# One APK per CPU architecture keeps the download small
flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi

# App bundle for the Play Store
flutter build appbundle --release

# Inject configuration without editing source
flutter build appbundle --release --dart-define=API_URL=https://api.example.com

# Keep symbols so crash reports stay readable
flutter build appbundle --release --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/symbols

# Web bundle goes to build/web
flutter build web --release --base-href /app/

# iOS archive for TestFlight, needs macOS and Xcode signing
flutter build ipa --release

# macOS and Windows desktop builds
flutter build macos --release
flutter build windows --release
